description: Set items' tags (name-value labels scripts attach to artwork; not shown in Illustrator's panels) and note (Attributes panel > Note). tags maps names to text values; null removes a tag. Tag names use letters, digits and underscores

clearTags.description: Remove every existing tag first. Default false

tags.description: Tag name to value (text), or null to remove that tag

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_item_data
title: Set Item Data
